title: Deuxième partie : variations sur l'équation des lacets [suite à La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois…, pages 293 à 650, dont table des matières] : notes et copies de notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting, from this and the previous page. S is a base scheme and F is a locally free O_S-module of rank 2, written F = O_S^2 locally. P is the projective line bundle of F, and G is the group PGL(F) = Aut_S(P). The objects ρ and σ are sections (automorphisms of F) whose images ρ̃, σ̃ in PGL satisfy ρ̃σ̃^{-1} = ε̃_1. Here ε_1 = 1 + N_1 is unipotent, and D = Im N_1 = Ker N_1 is the line L_1 with point x_1 ∈ P(S). After normalising λ_0 = 1 the relation becomes ρ = -ε_1σ. In the context of 'l'équation des lacets', σ and ρ are the lifts of the order-2 and order-3 generators of PSL_2(Z) ≅ Z/2 * Z/3, whose product is the unipotent 'lacet'.

The page finishes the proof of a Proposition from the previous page. The claim is that c = Tr σ + Tr ρ is invertible iff D + σ^{-1}D = F, i.e. iff σD + D = F.
- Trace computation: Tr ρ = -Tr(ε_1σ) = -Tr σ - Tr(N_1σ), so c = -Tr(N_1σ).
- Choose a local basis e_0, e_1 with e_1 spanning D and N_1 = [[0,0],[1,0]].
- Write σ = [[a,b],[c,d]]. Then N_1σ = [[0,0],[a,b]], so Tr(N_1σ) = b.
- D + σD = D + O·b e_0, which equals F iff b is a unit. QED.
- Geometric meaning: ρ^{-1}D = σ^{-1}ε_1^{-1}D = σ^{-1}D, so the condition says x_0 := ρ̃^{-1}(x_1) = σ̃^{-1}(x_1) is everywhere disjoint from x_1.

Under these equivalent conditions, L_0 and L_1 (eq. 23) are fibrewise distinct. They define opposite Borel subgroups B_0, B_1 of G. Their intersection T = B_0 ∩ B_1 (eq. 24) is a maximal torus, namely the common stabiliser of the sections x_0 and x_1, with x_1 = ρ̃x_0 = σ̃x_0 (eq. 25).

The next page develops this towards an 'épinglage'. It uses the bijection between Borels opposite to B_1 and maximal tori of B_1, together with the identification of P∖{x_1} as an affine line bundle under L_1. The purpose is to rigidify (épingler) the data (σ, ρ) as a representation of the Z/2 * Z/3 presentation into PGL_2 over an arbitrary base. It is a step towards classifying solutions of the 'lacets' relation in rank 2 (essentially the moduli of 'regular' pairs).
errors: Slip in the written formula σe_1 = a e_0 + b e_1. With the matrix convention actually used (N_1 = [[0,0],[1,0]] sends e_0 to e_1, so columns are images), σe_1 = b e_0 + d e_1. Grothendieck's next expression, D + σD = D + b e_0, uses the correct column, so the conclusion is unaffected.

Minor: the proposition was stated for a 'forme de GL(1)_S', but the computation is plainly in rank 2 (F locally O_S^2, P a P^1-bundle). This is presumably a slip, or GL(1) refers to some other indexing convention.

ideas.what: c = Tr σ + Tr ρ = -Tr(N_1σ) is invertible iff the line D = Im N_1 and σD span F (equivalently, the fixed point of the unipotent ε_1 is not fixed by ρ̃ or σ̃).
ideas.modern_name: Trace criterion for an irreducible / non-degenerate pair in a PSL_2(Z)-type representation (elementary linear algebra)

ideas.what: Two fibrewise-distinct sections of a P^1-bundle give opposite Borels B_0, B_1 of PGL(F) whose intersection is a maximal torus. Borels opposite to B_1 correspond to maximal tori of B_1.
ideas.modern_name: Opposite Borel subgroups; maximal torus as intersection of opposite Borels over a base scheme
ideas.where_published: SGA 3 (Exp. XXII, XXVI) in general form

ideas.what: Using these Borel/torus data to 'épingler' the rank-2 solutions of the lacets equation (σ of order 2, ρ of order 3, product unipotent) over an arbitrary base.
ideas.modern_name: Pinning (épinglage) and rigidification of SL_2/PGL_2-representations of PSL_2(Z) over a base
ideas.where_published: Related themes in Esquisse d'un programme / La Longue Marche (Teichmüller tower, lacets relations), but not this computation

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine 2×2 trace computation plus standard facts on opposite Borels and maximal tori. Its only interest is as a step in Grothendieck's unpublished scheme-theoretic analysis of rank-2 solutions of the 'équation des lacets'. Nothing here is new to a specialist.
transcription_corrections: The number '450' at the top is Grothendieck's own manuscript pagination.
The word inserted above the crossed-out 'opération sur' is not clearly 'involution'. It is a cursive superscript (possibly 'quelconque' or 'automorphisme'), so the reading is uncertain.
The image does read σe_1 = a e_0 + b e_1 (Grothendieck's slip, not a transcription error). It also reads D + σD = D + b e_0 with an extra scribble before e_0.
The insertion above the crossed-out 'paraboliques' at the bottom is likely 'toriques' or 'de Borel'. The reading is uncertain.
